## Overview

- Add semantic theme colors across Architecture DSL, Adaptive Cards, and Mermaid rendering.
- Add Adaptive Cards rendering and editable PowerPoint export.
- Keep the shared product version aligned at 4.2.7 across the Canvas Extension, Skill, npm CLI,
  and Desktop.

## Compatibility and migration

This patch release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and the v4
installation model. There are no breaking changes or new runtime requirements.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.2.7`. |
| Existing decks | No action is required; existing Markdown remains supported. |
| Adaptive Cards | Existing decks are unchanged; use the new rendering and PowerPoint export when needed. |
